description: Near-repeat (tss_goal_difference), reworded. Accuracy unchanged; win is cache reuse.

turns.query: What goal difference did Arsenal end the 2023-2024 Premier League season with?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_goal_difference FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2023-2024' AND tss_team = 'Arsenal';
